chooseWhenIntro: Continuing holds this time for you while you fill in the rest.
hourlyNotBookable: This service is charged by the hour and can't be booked here yet. Go back to the service and message the provider to arrange it.
whereOtherHint: You'll give it on the next step
railWhenPending: Choose a date and a time.
railTrustPayment: Payment is held until the service is finished.
railTrustVerified: The provider's documents are verified by Ntizo.
detailsIntro: Choose the address and, if you like, say what needs doing.
descriptionHint: Optional. Blue gate, third floor — anything that helps the provider come prepared.
loadError: We couldn't open this booking. Check your connection and try again.
storageBlockedTitle: This browser won't keep your details
storageBlockedBody: We need to hold the address in this tab until the request is sent, and this browser won't let us. Open the page in a normal (not private) window, or allow site data. Your time is still held.
sentBody: We've sent your request to {{provider}}. They have until {{time}} on {{date}} to confirm, and you only pay after that.
sentBodyNoDeadline: We've sent your request to {{provider}}. We'll tell you as soon as they answer, and you only pay after that.
unansweredTitle: The provider didn't answer in time
unansweredBody: The time to confirm ran out and the request was closed. Nothing was charged. You can choose another time.
declinedTitle: The provider turned this request down
declinedBody: Nothing was charged. You can choose another time, or look for a different provider.
awaitingPaymentTitle: The provider accepted — payment is next
awaitingPaymentBody: We've sent an M-Pesa payment request to your phone. Confirm it before the window closes, or the booking is cancelled.
paymentLapsedBody: The payment wasn't completed in time, so the booking was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
paidTitle: This booking is already paid for
paidBody: There is nothing left to fill in here. Message the provider if anything needs changing.
confirmIntro: Read back what you are asking for before it goes to the provider.
paymentMpesaHint: The payment request arrives on your Vodacom handset.
phoneHint: This is where we send the payment request, once the provider has confirmed the time.
phoneRequired: Enter the mobile number that will pay.
phoneNotVodacom: That number isn't a Vodacom one. M-Pesa only reaches numbers starting 84 or 85.
howItWorks1: You send the request to the provider.
howItWorks2: The provider confirms the time, or declines.
howItWorks3: Only then does the M-Pesa payment request arrive on your phone.
nothingChargedNow: Nothing is charged now. You only pay once the provider confirms the time.

createError.SLOT_ALREADY_TAKEN: Someone else has just booked that time. Please choose another.
createError.SLOT_NOT_OFFERED: That time is no longer available. Please choose another.
createError.SLOT_IN_PAST: That time has already passed. Please choose another.

createErrorGeneric: We couldn't hold this time right now. Please try again.

submitError.CUSTOMER_PHONE_MISSING: We need your mobile number to send this request. Check the number above and try again.
submitError.BOOKING_INVALID_TRANSITION: This request can no longer be sent — the time was released. Please choose another.

submitErrorGeneric: We couldn't send the request just now. Please try again.
holdExpired: Your time to finish ran out and the slot was released. Please choose another.
holdRemainingLabel: Time left to finish this booking
